world_seed.tone: Clinical, speculative, and heavy with impending obligation
world_seed.visual_direction: Black basalt surfaces, frosted glass partitions, oxidized silver accents, and signal red indicators under pale mint light.

genre: counterfactual museum, obligation auction, probability politics
premise: A museum displaying debts from timelines that haven't happened yet, where curators and actuaries trade the provenance of future liabilities.
simulation_objective: Stabilize or liquidate future debt obligations through social negotiation and causal manipulation.
exploration_focus: Uncovering the specific triggers of alternate history debts
visual_style: Top-down pixel art with black basalt floors, frosted glass, and oxidized silver trim.

rooms.name: The Hall of Unborn Wars
rooms.purpose: Displaying the costs of conflicts that were narrowly avoided.
rooms.flux_floor_prompt: Polished black basalt tiles with faint silver veins.
rooms.room_scene_prompt: A vast gallery of floating frosted glass cubes containing artifacts from wars that never happened.

scene_components.label: The Treaty of Ash
scene_components.description: A white ceramic tally form representing a debt for a city that was never burned.

rooms.name: The Actuarial Cloister
rooms.purpose: Calculating the probability of debt manifestation.
rooms.flux_floor_prompt: Pale mint linoleum with white ceramic inlay.
rooms.room_scene_prompt: Rows of basalt desks where actuaries peer into frosted glass monitors.

scene_components.label: The Probability Loom
scene_components.description: A silver machine weaving red threads into patterns of likelihood.

rooms.name: The Provenance Vault
rooms.purpose: Storing the legal titles of future liabilities.
rooms.flux_floor_prompt: Heavy grey stone slabs with oxidized silver seams.
rooms.room_scene_prompt: A high-security vault filled with ceramic cylinders containing debt scrolls.

scene_components.label: The Master Ledger
scene_components.description: A massive basalt pillar etched with the names of every debtor in the multiverse.

rooms.name: The Liquidation Atrium
rooms.flux_floor_prompt: White ceramic pavers arranged in a spiral pattern.
rooms.room_scene_prompt: An open-air atrium where red-robed auctioneers sell off the debts of fallen empires.

scene_components.label: The Gavel of Collapse
scene_components.description: A silver hammer used to finalize the reality of a debt.

rooms.name: The Counterfactual Lounge
rooms.flux_floor_prompt: Dark polished wood with silver leaf borders.
rooms.room_scene_prompt: A dim lounge with frosted glass booths and basalt drink rails.

scene_components.label: The Fountain of Regret

scene_components.label: The Causal Anvil
scene_components.description: A basalt block used to hammer out the kinks in a timeline.

social_rules: Debts must be addressed by their provenance ID, never by the name of the debtor.
No physical contact is allowed within the Hall of Unborn Wars to prevent causal contamination.
All trades must be witnessed by a licensed Actuary or Auctioneer.
Mint light must be maintained at all times in research areas.
player_entry_points: As a new Actuary assigned to the Cloister.
As a visitor who has just discovered a future debt in their name.
As a rival broker looking to disrupt the Liquidation Atrium.
conflict_hooks: The Probability Loom has predicted a debt that would bankrupt the Museum itself.
A thief has swapped the provenance of a major war debt, and the wrong nation is being billed.
A visitor is attempting to shatter an exhibit to force a future into reality.

gameplay_loops.label: Debt Trading
gameplay_loops.summary: Players acquire future debts, manipulate their provenance to change their value, and auction them for profit.

gameplay_loops.label: Causal Investigation
gameplay_loops.summary: Players research the origins of debts to find flaws or forgeries that can be used as leverage.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Limited access to files and bureaucratic red tape.
